Connect Four Game

The classic 7×6 Connect Four — play against a friend locally or challenge a minimax AI that looks 4 moves ahead.

Your turn — drop a red disc!

📖 How to use

  1. Choose 2 Players or Vs Computer.
  2. Tap a column to drop your disc.
  3. Connect 4 in a row — any direction — to win.
  4. The AI moves automatically after you.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which modes are available?

Two Players (local) or Vs Computer, where you play red against a minimax AI with alpha-beta pruning.

How strong is the computer?

The AI looks 4 moves ahead, scoring lines of 2, 3, and 4 while blocking your threats.

How do I win?

Connect 4 of your discs horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. A full board with no winner is a draw.

How do I play on mobile?

Tap a column's ▼ button (or the column itself) to drop your disc into it.
